purpose: Measure how much a student model improves when the loop gives it what it lacks, with the same model answering every round: evidence for knowledge questions, reasoning and repeated reasoning for multiple-choice questions it is unsure of.

vm14k.selection: lowest sha256(seed, dataset:item) among the four-option items outside the MC-95 manifest

knowledge.selection: lowest sha256(seed, dataset:item) among the K2 pool items (ViBidLQA train with a unique question, outside MC-95) that are outside the MC-96 manifest

arm_meaning.B: multiple choice: the frozen answer-letter prompt; knowledge: the closed-book prompt of K2 (the question only, no passage)
arm_meaning.S: the campaign's step-by-step prompt ending in a final-answer line
arm_meaning.K: the frozen reading prompt with retrieved clauses where the passage would be: the top 2 of the registered K2 BM25 ranking in dataset bidlqa-closed-book, the top 5 of the same ranking in dataset bidlqa-closed-book-top5
arm_meaning.O: the frozen reading prompt with the item's own clause (a ceiling, not deployable)

qwen.route: the campaign transport of data/diagnostic_prospective_v1/protocol.json (IEC endpoint, Responses API, temperature 1.0, 4,096 output tokens), for every arm except the multiple-choice B

probe.confidence: the probability of the parsed letter, renormalized over the letters the item offers (run_mc_calibration_eval.letter_probs and offered_letters); missing when fewer than two offered letters are visible, or when the option block cannot be read (an option broken across lines; two VM14K items)

qwen.unsure: confidence below the threshold, or missing

mimo.unsure: the two B answers differ or one is empty

loop.round_2: S-r1. Qwen keeps B when S-r1 equals it; MiMo keeps S-r1 when it equals one of its B answers
loop.round_3: otherwise S-r2 and S-r3 are added and the majority of the three S answers is final; a tie goes to S-r1; an empty answer casts no vote

threshold_rule.rule: the smallest threshold on the grid 0.50, 0.55, ..., 0.95 whose two-round loop (B at temperature 0 kept when confident, otherwise S-r1) scores at least always-S minus 1.0 accuracy point on the design data
threshold_rule.design_data: the 660 VMLU valid items of MC-94 and MC-95: B at temperature 0 and its confidence from MC-43, S-r1 from MC-94 and MC-95

multiple_choice.pooled: VMLU dev and VM14K together (603 items); per dataset is descriptive

policies.always_vote: the majority of S-r1, S-r2 and S-r3, a tie to S-r1
policies.map: the point map of MC-95 and MC-103: Qwen VMLU S and VM14K B; MiMo VMLU B and VM14K S

primary.test: exact McNemar of the loop against always_B, two-sided, Holm over the two students
primary.met: Holm p below alpha and the loop scores higher

primary.test: the mean paired difference loop minus always_S with a percentile bootstrap interval (2,000 resamples, seed 7)
primary.met: the lower bound is above -1.0 point and the loop's mean reported tokens are below always_S's

multiple_choice.tokens: per item, the reported tokens of every request the policy's rounds use

knowledge.score: token-F1 under vi-reading-v3 (primary) with vi-reading-v2 and exact match beside

primary.test: mean paired token-F1 difference K top 5 minus K top 2 with a two-sided sign-flip p-value (20,000 resamples, seed 7), Holm over the two students
primary.met: Holm p below alpha and K top 5 scores higher

descriptive: K top 5 as a share of O
K top 2 as a share of O
the rank of the own clause in the BM25 ranking: in the top 2, in the top 5, missed
